	city_graphics_type = ztr_ind_indian_wood_late_modern
	city_graphics_type = ztr_ind_indian_wood_postmodern
	city_graphics_type = ztr_ind_indian_wood_digital
	city_graphics_type = ztr_ind_indian_wood_ai
	priority = 2
	grid_size = { 5 3 }
	should_update_on_pm_change = yes

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			"b(building_renewable_energy_power_plant)" ?= {
				OR = {
					is_under_construction = yes
					level > 0
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			any_scope_state = {
				"b(building_airport)" ?= {
					OR = {
						is_under_construction = yes
						level > 0
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	locator = { name = ztr_centre position = { 1.5 0 0 } rotation = { 0 0 0 } scale = 1.0 }
	locator = { name = ztr_renewable position = { -1.0 0 0 } rotation = { 0 0 0 } scale = 1.0 }
	composition_group = {
		composition = { name = ztr_wind trigger = { any_scope_building = { has_active_production_method = pm_wind_turbines } } }
		composition = { name = ztr_solar trigger = { any_scope_building = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_rudimental_photovoltaic_cells has_active_production_method = pm_solar_panels } } } }
	}
	attach = { locator = ztr_centre variant = { entity = indian_forestry_centerpiece_01_entity } }
	attach = {
		locator = ztr_renewable
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_wind_01_entity	building_type = building_renewable_energy_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_wind } }
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_power_solar_01_entity	building_type = building_renewable_energy_power_plant	compositions = { ztr_solar } }

	city_graphics_type = ztr_ssa_wood_early_modern
	city_graphics_type = ztr_ssa_wood_late_modern
	city_graphics_type = ztr_ssa_wood_postmodern
	city_graphics_type = ztr_ssa_wood_digital
	city_graphics_type = ztr_ssa_wood_ai
	priority = 2
	grid_size = { 4 6 }
	should_update_on_pm_change = yes

	trigger = {
		any_scope_state = {
			"b(building_airport)" ?= {
				OR = {
					is_under_construction = yes
					level > 0
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			any_scope_state = {
				"b(building_renewable_energy_power_plant)" ?= {
					OR = {
						is_under_construction = yes
						level > 0
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	locator = { name = ztr_centre position = { -1.0 0 0 } rotation = { 0 0 0 } scale = 1.0 }
	locator = { name = ztr_airport position = { 1.0 0 0 } rotation = { 0 0 0 } scale = 1.0 }
	attach = { locator = ztr_centre variant = { entity = african_forestry_centerpiece_01_entity } }
	attach = {
		locator = ztr_airport
		variant = { entity = ztr_global_transport_airport_01_entity	building_type = building_airport }
	}
}
